review_scope: Independent public-city-map locator closure and physical-status assessment for one QTS Aurora/Denver DEN1 campus; research only. No curated or strict geometry proposal, admission, central code or frozen source changes.

candidate.name: QTS Aurora-Denver DEN1 Campus
candidate.campus_grouping: One physical campus, not separate additions for DC1/DC2/DC3. Existing DC1 occupancy does not establish completion of all campus expansion.
candidate.old_identity_review: Read all 166 selected stable keys and names. QTS Denver/Aurora/DEN1 and exact Gun Club Road address search across source JSONs and local v97 entities.csv found no older match. No old key changed.

physical_status_assessment.source_authority: KUNC publishes Sara Wilson / Colorado Newsline article through Colorado News Collaborative; the original photograph is credited to Chase Woodruff / Colorado Newsline and its visible caption expressly identifies construction on a data-center expansion at the QTS Aurora site on August 6.
physical_status_assessment.literal_pointer: Visible lead photograph credit/caption immediately below the article title and publication line. Article close states the story was made available via the Colorado News Collaborative.
physical_status_assessment.minimal_literal_excerpt: Construction on a data center expansion
physical_status_assessment.authority_judgment: This is stronger than an unattributed publicity paraphrase: a specifically dated original-photographer observation carried in a public credited syndication. It is nevertheless news-source observation, not a city inspector or company physical statement. Final reviewer must explicitly accept that first-hand reporting authority under the unchanged contract; no status selected in this packet.
physical_status_assessment.date_caveat: Use day precision only. Visible publication time and structured publication UTC value differ; no exact publication instant normalized. August 6 belongs to the caption, not the page retrieval.
physical_status_assessment.scope_caveat: Caption is campus-expansion generic and does not identify DC2 versus DC3 or assert all buildings unfinished. If accepted, select generic campus expansion project scope and one campus, not a specific observed hall.
physical_status_assessment.imagery_caveat: No photograph downloaded separately, republished, or independently visually verified. No imagery outcome or image-use right is asserted.
physical_status_assessment.source_reuse: Only short factual restatement and attribution. Licensed public syndication is an access/publication context, not an assumed open license for the photograph or prose.

city_physical_status_review.literal_pointer: /features[*]/attributes/Permit_, Status_1, FolderDescription, IssueDate, PropertyRSN and Address
city_physical_status_review.assessment: Four exact project/address records corroborate identity. Two have Initial Inspection status but no inspection date. IssueDate and InDate are application/permit events, not dated physical inspections; September retrieval must not backdate those status labels.

records.project: QTS DEN1 DC1 interior data hall tenant improvement

records.condition_caveat: May 20 permit extension note precedes the observation window and is not physical work.

records.project: QTS DEN1 DC1 data hall remodeling with exterior work

city_physical_status_review.public_documents: Direct city address hyperlinks returned 27 DC2 documents and 8 DC3 documents, consisting of permits/plans/plot plans, not dated inspection reports. Listing keywords expressly bind QTS DEN1 DC2 to 1140; DC3 plans bind 1100. Release dates are document publication events only; no plans downloaded.

successor_review.dc1: 1160 address record says CO_ISSUED YES and CO_DATE 07/05/2024. Existing first-hall occupancy must remain excluded from current expansion lifecycle.
successor_review.dc2_dc3: Both current address records say CO_ISSUED NO with null CO_DATE; exact 2026 CO layer query returns zero features. This is bounded absence, not proof of nonoperation or continued work.
successor_review.broader_cancellation_scope: The KUNC article describes several other jurisdictions' moratoria. None is normalized as a QTS Aurora stop. No campus-wide completion/cancellation was established here.

locator_review.query: Exact three addresses, only project-bound attribute fields, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, datumTransformation=1188. No bulk extraction, geocoding or locator substitution.
locator_review.derivation: City address-point geometry transformed by official server from native EPSG:2232 to WGS84 using explicit EPSG:1188; selected output is copied literally from that response. Native geometry is not the nearly equal POINT_X/POINT_Y attribute pair.
locator_review.coordinate_attribute_caveat: Stored LATITUDE/LONGITUDE attributes differ slightly from the explicitly transformed geometry; their unstated transformation is not borrowed or silently equated. The address point is not a parcel, surveyed entrance or actual new-work footprint.

local_check.operation: Inverse of SPCS83 Colorado Central zone (US survey foot) + NAD83 to WGS 84 (1) (axis order normalized for visualization)
local_check.caveat: Preferred NOAA Colorado HPGN grid was unavailable in the cached offline runtime; no grid downloaded. The explicit available EPSG:1188 operation was selected and checked, not claimed the best possible transformation.

locator_review.accuracy_caveat: Four-metre operation accuracy is not source positional accuracy. City disclaimers provide no numerical locator accuracy; decimal precision is not survey accuracy.

other_same_campus_points.scope: DC3 constituent identity; permit alone supplies no physical observation.

rights_review.fact: The public app and map expose Aurora's Data Download Disclaimer: data were developed for city internal use; no warranties or accuracy guarantee; use at requestor risk; indemnification and hold-harmless language. No broad open-data redistribution grant is stated.
rights_review.interpretation_limit: No claim that those terms grant redistribution or that their enforceability was legally assessed. Proposed reuse is only one isolated official address coordinate plus compact named-project facts with City of Aurora attribution; final reviewer must adjudicate. Do not redistribute full city map, plan, geometry collection or disclaimer prose.
rights_review.operator_stop: QTS operator page geometry is excluded because parent identified restrictive AI language in its legal notices. This subtask did not fetch or parse that operator body.

dedup_review.method: Shapely 2.1.2 exact Point intersections against every complete baseline geometry, not display anchors. Separate tests for all three city constituent points.
dedup_review.mutual_grouping: All three points belong to this one DEN1 campus. They are not three independent candidate sites.
